name: Rangefinder
description: A compact rangefinder-style mirrorless camera with a flat-topped body about 128 millimetres wide by 74 tall by 36 deep and a fixed prime lens projecting a further 32 millimetres, its machined silver aluminium top plate and matching base plate each carrying a bright polished chamfer along their outer edge, a black pebbled-texture wrap covering the body's mid-band and trimmed to a crisp even line against both plates, two knurled silver dials with chamfered rims flanking an empty machined hot-shoe slot, a small round optical viewfinder window at the front upper-left, a flush rear display under a single sheet of glass with hairline bezels equal on all four sides and a screen corner radius concentric with the body's, and a black anodised prime lens with a knurled focus ring, a milled aperture ring and a slightly domed front element carrying a faint blue-violet coating flare.
materials: machined silver aluminium top plate and base plate with bright polished outer chamfers and a fine anisotropic machining grain, black pebbled-texture grip wrap with a crisply trimmed edge, knurled silver machined dials with chamfered rims, flush machined buttons with fine chamfers, black anodised fixed prime lens barrel with a knurled focus ring and a milled aperture ring, a slightly domed multi-coated front element
primaryColors: machined silver, black textured grip wrap, black lens barrel
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraved numerals, aperture or shutter scales, index numbers, or printing anywhere on the top plate, dials, lens barrel, grip wrap, or base, and never render readable interface text, icons, menus, a status bar, or any recognisable operating system on the rear display, which is either fully dark or lit with an abstract non-textual gradient; never render a third top-plate dial, a second shutter button, a pentaprism hump, an interchangeable-lens mount ring, a detached or zooming lens, or a second viewfinder window; never render mismatched or non-concentric corner radii between the rear display and the body, bezels of unequal width, a smudged microphone perforation instead of real drilled holes, or a proud unchamfered button; never swap the machined silver top plate for black, the pebbled grip wrap for smooth plastic, or the fixed prime for a long zoom; never reproduce the silhouette, dial layout, badge, or trade dress of any real camera manufacturer's product Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: the flat machined silver aluminium top plate and matching base plate with their bright polished outer chamfers, the roughly 128 by 74 by 36 millimetre body proportion with the fixed prime projecting a further 32 millimetres, the black pebbled-texture wrap covering the body's mid-band and front and trimmed to a crisp even line against both plates, exactly two knurled silver dials on the top plate with plain milled faces carrying only fine index notches and no numerals, one shutter button with a concentric silver collar switch at the right dial's base, one empty machined hot-shoe slot centred between the dials with two precisely drilled microphone pinholes just ahead of it, one small round optical viewfinder window at the front upper-left, one fixed black prime lens with a knurled focus ring, a milled aperture ring and a slightly domed multi-coated front element, one flush rear display under a single sheet of glass with hairline bezels equal on all four sides and its corner radius concentric with the body's, one flush rubber port door on the left flank, and one small round status lamp at the upper right of the back must read identically in every angle, same body proportions, dial diameter and lens projection throughout When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
